summary: Iteration 2 comprehensive testing (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 17/17 pass: admin auth (login success/wrong pw/me with & without Bearer/brute-force lockout on throwaway email), admin dashboard endpoints (stats/list+q/pagination/CSV export headers/delete + 404/settings GET+PUT+422 invalid email/notifications list), email alert integration (demo submission produces a notification within ~5s; newsletter does NOT), and full 3-turn chat booking flow (SSE `demo_booked` event, submission persisted with source='chat', history free of tool messages). Frontend end-to-end: /admin redirect + wrong-pw error + successful login + stats/table/type filter/search-debounce/leads-count/row dialog/delete/CSV blob download/Alerts settings save/notifications list/logout/reload persistence via solix_admin_token in localStorage. Article pages: non-gated /resources/archive-first-fastest-path-to-s4hana renders with author, TOC, copy-link, sidebar-demo; gated /resources/build-enterprise-archive-in-the-cloud shows gate, LeadForm submit unlocks (Unlocked badge appears, gate disappears); unknown slug -> not-found-page. Chat booking on Home: suggestion click -> 3-turn flow -> chat-booking-card rendered with name/email/company; markdown rendered (no literal ** visible). Zero console errors across flows. Alert email restored to delivered@resend.dev at end. NOTE: request text mentioned data-testids lead-form-name/email/company/submit but actual DOM uses lead-name-input, lead-email-input, lead-company-input, lead-submit-button — test used the real testids.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login_attempts: identifier keyed by ip:email; on shared/proxy IPs multiple admins could interfere — acceptable for single-admin app but note in RCA if scale grows.
admin.py list_submissions: default page_size=25 differs from request text example (=5); OK because explicit page_size in query works — but ensure frontend passes it.
emailer.notify_lead runs inline in request path (awaited by server.py). If Emergent email endpoint is slow, submission response is delayed. Consider fire-and-forget via BackgroundTasks.
admin.py stats: `chat_leads` counts source='chat' across ALL types; description says chat leads — acceptable but document.
LeadForm data-testids use `lead-{field}-input` / `lead-submit-button` — review_request wrote `lead-form-name` etc. Docs/testids mismatch — update review_request or add aliases.
server.py still on deprecated `on_event('startup')` pattern (carried from iter 1).
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed submissions created during backend + gated-article + chat-booking flows. Chat sessions have random book-<hex> ids. Alert email restored to delivered@resend.dev after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (all iter1 + iter2 tests, ~30s). Use throwaway email for brute-force test to avoid locking admin@solix.com for 15 min. Chat booking flow needs ~60s per LLM turn, allow 60-90s stream timeout. LeadForm testids: lead-name-input / lead-email-input / lead-company-input / lead-submit-button (NOT lead-form-name etc). Article pages: non-gated=archive-first-fastest-path-to-s4hana, gated=build-enterprise-archive-in-the-cloud. Admin token key: 'solix_admin_token' in localStorage.
